batch: Raspberry Pi Imager v2.0.12 package candidate source review

installEffects: Installs application files and registers a Start menu shortcut.
Registers image/archive and Raspberry Pi Imager manifest file associations in machine registry hives.
Stages rpiboot-winusb.inf with pnputil /add-driver /install, which may apply the driver to currently connected devices.
Can terminate a running rpi-imager.exe after an interactive confirmation during setup; silent-mode launch is skipped.
upgradeEffects: Setup detects and removes earlier Inno/NSIS registrations and performs legacy file/registry cleanup before completing the new install.
uninstallEffects: Enumerates the Windows driver store for rpiboot-winusb.inf and deletes the matching published OEM driver package with pnputil /delete-driver /uninstall.
Deletes the current user's cached OS image when the HKCU lastFileName value identifies a file named lastdownload.cache.
Deletes the current user's imagecustomization registry subtree, which contains saved Wi-Fi credentials, Linux account password hashes, and SSH keys.
Intentionally preserves other current-user settings such as window position, language, telemetry choice and last path.
